title: Definition of State
description: Defines 'State' for purposes of fundamental rights - includes Government and Parliament of India, State Governments and Legislatures, local authorities, and other authorities

title: Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights
description: Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights to be void. State shall not make any law which takes away or abridges fundamental rights

title: Equality before law
description: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or equal protection of laws within territory of India

title: Prohibition of discrimination
description: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth

title: Equality of opportunity in public employment
description: Equality of opportunity for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State

title: Abolition of untouchability
description: Untouchability is abolished and its practice in any form is forbidden. Enforcement of any disability arising out of untouchability is an offence

title: Abolition of titles
description: No title except military or academic shall be conferred by the State. Citizens of India cannot accept titles from any foreign State

title: Protection of six freedoms
description: Protection of freedom of speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence and profession

title: Protection in respect of conviction
description: Protection against ex post facto laws, double jeopardy, and self-incrimination

title: Protection of life and personal liberty
description: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law

title: Right to education
description: The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all children between age of six to fourteen years

title: Protection against arrest and detention
description: Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases, right to be informed of grounds, right to consult legal practitioner

title: Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour
description: Traffic in human beings and begar and other similar forms of forced labour are prohibited

title: Prohibition of child labour
description: No child below age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment

title: Freedom of conscience and religion
description: All persons are equally entitled to freedom of conscience and right freely to profess, practice and propagate religion

title: Freedom to manage religious affairs
description: Every religious denomination has the right to establish and maintain institutions, manage its own affairs, own and acquire property

title: Freedom from taxation for promotion of religion
description: No person shall be compelled to pay any taxes for promotion or maintenance of any particular religion

title: Freedom from attending religious instruction
description: No religious instruction shall be provided in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds

title: Protection of interests of minorities
description: Any section of citizens with distinct language, script or culture have right to conserve the same

title: Right of minorities to establish educational institutions
description: All minorities have right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice

title: Right to Constitutional Remedies
description: Right to move Supreme Court for enforcement of fundamental rights. Supreme Court can issue writs including habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto and certiorari

title: Definition of State
description: Definition of State for Part IV same as Article 12

title: Application of Directive Principles
description: Directive Principles are fundamental in governance but not enforceable by any court

title: State to secure social order for welfare
description: State shall secure a social order for promotion of welfare of people by minimizing inequalities

title: Certain principles of policy
description: State to direct policy towards securing adequate means of livelihood, equal pay for equal work, protection of children

title: Equal justice and free legal aid
description: State shall secure operation of legal system promoting justice on basis of equal opportunity and provide free legal aid

title: Organisation of village panchayats
description: State shall organize village panchayats and endow them with powers and authority for self-government

title: Right to work, education and public assistance
description: State shall make effective provision for securing right to work, education and public assistance in certain cases

title: Just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief
description: State shall make provisions for securing just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief

title: Living wage for workers
description: State shall endeavour to secure living wage and decent standard of life for all workers

title: Uniform civil code
description: State shall endeavour to secure uniform civil code for citizens throughout territory of India

title: Provision for early childhood care and education
description: State shall endeavour to provide early childhood care and education for all children until they complete age of six years

title: Promotion of educational and economic interests of weaker sections
description: State shall promote educational and economic interests of weaker sections, particularly SC and ST

title: Duty to raise level of nutrition and standard of living
description: State shall raise level of nutrition and standard of living and improve public health

title: Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry
description: State shall organize agriculture and animal husbandry on modern and scientific lines

title: Protection and improvement of environment
description: State shall protect and improve environment and safeguard forests and wildlife

title: Protection of monuments
description: State shall protect every monument or place of artistic or historic interest

title: Separation of judiciary from executive
description: State shall separate judiciary from executive in public services of the State

title: Promotion of international peace and security
description: State shall promote international peace and security, maintain just relations between nations
